# Horizon POS & Loyalty Rollout

- **Goal / definition of done:** cut over the store to the new **Horizon POS** with integrated **Summit
  Rewards** loyalty at the register, all associates trained and certified, no checkout disruption.
- **Owner:** Marc, with [Tanya Brooks](../people/tanya-brooks.md) owning associate **training** and
  [Priya Nair](../people/priya-nair.md) (ran the Westfield pilot) as Marc's advisor on gotchas.
- **Status (CURRENT):** **go-live SLIPPED to 2026-08-17.** *(It was originally scheduled for 2026-07-20 —
  that date is no longer valid; see the [log](../log/2026-07-15-pos-slip.md).)*
- **Why it slipped:** register **hardware** delivery ran late and associate **training** wasn't complete in
  time for the original date.
- **Open items:**
  - Complete **POS training sign-off** for all associates before go-live (commitment due 2026-08-14).
  - Confirm the rescheduled hardware install with the vendor.
  - Day-of cutover plan and a fallback if the loyalty tie-in has issues.
